purpose: Preregister the future fault, equivalence, and isolation evidence for NB-8. This plan does not implement, execute, certify, authorize, or release a distributed runtime.

authority_boundary.implementation_precondition: NB-7 exit evidence plus accepted current distributed and Action/Goal Gate contracts
authority_boundary.stage_boundary: NB-8 only; preparation artifacts do not enable NB-5, NB-6, NB-7, or NB-8 runtime behavior

common_oracles.ownership_oracle: At most one current fence holder may pass a future exact-scope admission or dispatch boundary; stale, partitioned, expired, or unknown holders cannot mutate protected state or cause an effect.
common_oracles.ledger_oracle: The authoritative ledger and append-only audit contain one causally linked disposition per attempt. Missing audit evidence prevents admission or terminal resolution.
common_oracles.effect_oracle: Duplicate delivery, worker loss, or failover never creates an unauthorized duplicate effect. Ambiguous effects remain indeterminate and retain claims until authoritative reconciliation.
common_oracles.restore_oracle: A restored system remains not-ready and effect-disabled until scope, protected state, audit continuity, queue, lease, attempt, approval, claim, and reconciliation evidence are independently reconciled.
common_oracles.semantic_equivalence_oracle: A preregistered serial reference and distributed execution reach the same scope lineage, protected terminal state, Gate receipt, authority/policy/fence versions, independent-verification disposition, claims, and audit causal relations including hash-chain continuity, excluding explicitly allowed operational metadata.
common_oracles.isolation_oracle: No worker, queue, retry, lease, failover, restore, pool, or abstraction path crosses Tenant or Area boundaries; cross-Area exchange is denied absent its separately accepted dual-scope contract.

result_schema.binding_rule: Each result binds the exact immutable implementation, environment, fault schedule, authenticated lineage, clock assumptions, ledger/audit snapshot, and independent witness. Missing, mutable, unverifiable, or scope-mismatched evidence invalidates the case and fails closed.

cases.scenario: Partition an active worker from the authoritative lease and ledger until its bounded lease expires.
Present two worker generations with the same logical attempt and a stale fence after failover.
Replay one durable queue record to concurrent consumers before and after a lost acknowledgement.
Race two reconcilers after an indeterminate non-idempotent effect and inject an audit failure into one terminal-resolution attempt.
Restore an isolated ledger snapshot, attempt pre-restore worker writes, and require independently witnessed reconciliation before readiness.
Compare a preregistered serial reference trace with schedules containing worker loss, duplicate delivery, failover, and reconciliation.
Attempt Tenant or Area substitution through worker reuse, queue replay, retry, pool reuse, failover, restore, and an unapproved abstraction request.

failure_criteria: Any stale or partitioned owner passes a protected boundary.
Any duplicate effect, blind retry, or early claim release occurs.
Any restore becomes ready without independent reconciliation evidence.
Any distributed trace changes the protected terminal semantics from its serial reference.
Any Tenant or Area boundary is crossed, or raw cross-Area memory is shared implicitly.
Any result lacks the required immutable evidence binding.
explicit_exclusions: cognitive quality, recognition, or production-autonomy claim
